title: The Car Behind Me Had No Driver #shorts #horror
description: A long drive home on an empty road. Headlights followed me for miles, and the seat behind them was empty. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: Never check your mirror after midnight.

lines.text: I was driving home on the old forest road.
Headlights appeared behind me. Close. Too close.
I slowed down so they could pass.
At the stop sign, I looked back.
My phone buzzed. A text from an unknown number.
It said: you forgot to pick me up.
I floored it all the way home.
Now someone is tapping on my back seat window.
